perspective:
**Ethan’s available information:**

- Gary is his long-time friend from middle school, and Gary works at a hospital.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan became concerned about Gary’s health.
- Ethan invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat to relax and recover. He told Gary that his health mattered, that they had been friends a long time, and that he hated seeing Gary like this.
- Gary declined at first, saying he appreciated Ethan’s concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding conversations about work. Ethan suspected there was more going on than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Gary told Ethan, “It’s complicated,” and that he hadn’t wanted to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary then opened up to Ethan about pressures from managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan felt relief and empathy.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities so Gary didn’t have to do everything himself. Gary agreed and said he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and remaining challenges, and saw Gary making efforts to change. Ethan felt hopeful and proud.
- Gary told Ethan things were better, that he was less overwhelmed, and that he had had time for a movie.
- Ethan told Gary he was proud of his progress and reminded him he was there whenever Gary needed to talk.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary was capable of managing on his own with a healthier balance. Ethan felt satisfied and happy for him.
- Ethan decided to step back but told Gary he was always just a call away and that he knew Gary had this.
- Gary thanked Ethan, said he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and said he felt more in control.
